The [[Convocation]] is an annually held celebration among the [[Luxon|Luxon Armada]]. During the Convocation, the three Luxon Clans - the [[Crab Clan]], the [[Serpent Clan]], and the [[Turtle Clan]] - send their champions and their elite guards to battle each other to the death. The victorious clan is awarded the [[Spear of Archemorus]] and the honor to slay [[Zhu Hanuku]]. When Zhu Hanuku is slain, the energy from the [[Kraken]] is used to resurrect the fallen fighters. The victorious clan keeps the Spear of Archemorus for the entire year, until the next Convocation.

==Notes==
*Players take part in the Convocation during the mission [[Boreas Seabed]].
*The town description for [[Cavalon]] claims that the Convocation occurs once a decade; however, more sources say that it occurs annually.
